# KARTEL — public registry of the KARTEL federation

> kartel.org.uk opens on the coat of arms of the Kartel family, and is the public registry of the KARTEL federation of cultural and educational platforms (KARTEL Core). Based in London, United Kingdom. Motto: "Virtus et Potestas" (Strength and Power). Bilingual: English and Russian.

## KARTEL Core

Cultural and educational platforms share one identity, one map of UK regions and one organisation model. KARTEL Core keeps those shared layers and the rules every platform follows — this site is their public record. The registry observes; it is not a workflow, a database, or a runtime dependency.

- **Canonical layers**: Identity (CPIF — one person, one identity across every platform), Geography (ITL1 — canonical UK region taxonomy), Organisations (CEA → Foundation → School → Venue), Federation (the integration gate).
- **Federation Integration Gate**: eight requirements every project joining the federation passes before production (authentication, canonical geography, organisation anchor, membership contract, permission pattern, event geo-anchor, notification envelope, audit envelope). Each platform signs its users in by its own sound method; no shared sign-in service is required.
- **Ecosystem projects**:
  - MoyPolk (moypolk.uk) — Immortal Regiment UK memorial platform; produces and serves the canonical geography taxonomy.
  - RusJAz (rusjaz.com) — Russian-language education marketplace and LMS; consumes geography, organisation and campus anchors.
  - Community Group (community.group) — cultural funding and trust platform (CEA); consumes geography.
  - RusJAzz — a separate future module; builds against the Federation Integration Gate from day one.

- [Full content for LLMs](https://kartel.org.uk/llms-full.txt) — Complete text of the public pages

The Family Heritage area (/en/family) is members-only: family members sign in with a link sent to their approved email address.

## Key facts

- **Family name**: Kartel (Картель)
- **Motto**: Virtus et Potestas (Strength and Power / Сила и Власть)
- **Location**: London, United Kingdom
- **Languages**: English, Russian
- **Domain**: kartel.org.uk
